intro: Bruneian culture is shaped by Malay traditions, Islam and the royal family.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: The golden-domed Sultan Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque stands by a lagoon. Kampong Ayer, the water village, is home to thousands of people.

chapters.title: Food
text: Ambuyat, a sticky starch from the sago palm eaten with sour sauces, is the national dish.

keyTerms.meaning: A starchy dish made from sago.
